description: This Java source file defines the ElevationDragFragment class, which manages a UI fragment allowing users to manipulate the elevation (Z-position) of a circular view via button clicks and drag interactions. It includes outline shape customization, elevation adjustments, and event handling for UI controls.

classes.name: ElevationDragFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that enables users to adjust a circular view's elevation interactively, with support for drag-based elevation changes and custom view outlines.

classes.name: ElevationDragFragment.CircleOutlineProvider
classes.description: A private inner class extending ViewOutlineProvider, providing an oval outline matching the view's bounds for shadow rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the outline provider and elevation step size from resources.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up views, configures outline and clipping, initializes drag behavior, and sets up button click handlers for adjusting elevation.
